questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes std::array in C++?

options.text: std::array owns a fixed number of elements
use it when size is known at compile time
its size cannot grow at runtime
The compiler automatically repairs the design

questions.explanation: std::array owns a fixed number of elements. Confirm with a minimal C++20 program, strict warnings, and tests.

questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes std::vector in C++?
